Team hiring for tapeout and production ramp roles

ko.executive_summary: Samsung Foundry targeting 100% utilization with booming 2nm AI chip orders while achieving full 4nm capacity bookings through next year. TSMC accelerating 3nm to 180,000 wafers monthly and pushing 2nm toward 100,000 wafer capacity to capture AI-driven demand and TSMC spillover orders from China and India. Trump administration imposed 15% tariffs on polysilicon derivatives with $21/kg minimum import pricing.
key_facts: Samsung Foundry 4nm production fully booked through 2026
Samsung pushing 5nm capacity to capture TSMC spillover from China and India
TSMC boosting 3nm output to 180,000 wafers monthly
TSMC advancing 2nm toward 100,000 wafer monthly capacity
Anthropic exploring Samsung 2nm for custom AI chips
Trump administration imposed 15% tariff on polysilicon derivatives
Polysilicon minimum import price set at $21 per kilogram
POSTECH and Samsung Electronics co-developing 3D NAND advancement
Tesla Terafab Texas first phase $16.8 billion with memory engineering hiring signals DRAM focus
NHN FactoryX operating 7,656 GPUs across Seoul data center

implications.text: Full 4nm bookings and 2nm demand surge reflect acute foundry supply constraints for AI inference and training chips through 2026
Samsung and TSMC capacity competition targeting geographic spillover indicates accelerating fragmentation away from single-source dependency
Trump's polysilicon tariff ($21/kg floor pricing) increases manufacturing costs for all fabs and may suppress wafer output growth
Tesla's Terafab memory engineering hires and 3D NAND advancement suggest foundry customers pursuing in-house capability development

ko.counterpoint: Polysilicon tariff impact timing and enforcement mechanisms remain uncertain; current headline capacity bookings may not guarantee sustained utilization amid AI spending volatility.
